# Copilot instructions for ProfeIA

- This repository contains a Python FastAPI backend, a Kivy/KivyMD frontend, and Supabase-backed data models.
- Favor small, incremental changes that respect the existing architecture.
- Keep Python source ASCII-clean and avoid introducing encoding issues on Windows.
- Match the style already used in nearby files before introducing new patterns.
- Update documentation or migrations when a feature changes the API or persistence layer.
- Validate changes with the most relevant available check before finishing.
